beats.text: Your multi-agent AI system has a dirty secret. It loves running in circles and spending five figures on tokens.
beats.show_cue: An enterprise cloud billing dashboard with a spiking token consumption line.

beats.text: Enterprise startup Writer took an open Chinese model called GLM-5.2 and built a custom harness specifically designed to stop runaway API bills.
beats.show_cue: The Writer platform architecture page highlighting the token budget harness.

beats.text: The harness enforces strict per-task token budgets, automatic context caching, and real-time prompt compression. Here is the simple version. It puts a taxi meter inside the car that cuts the engine when the fare gets too high.
beats.show_cue: The token governor configuration screen showing custom budget caps per task.

beats.text: The catch. Aggressive compression can strip subtle instructions. If your prompt has strict legal rules, trimming tokens might trim the rule.
beats.show_cue: A prompt comparison view highlighting trimmed instructions in red.

beats.text: If you manage enterprise AI spend, look into execution harnesses. The frontier models are cheap, but sloppy loops are not.
beats.show_cue: Operator on camera, budget report summary in corner inset.
